---
title: "Turn / BC onsets: GAMs"
---

The `place * back + place * mode_back` models from `turn_bc_explore.qmd`, refitted as GAMs: a smooth for each main effect, tensor-product interactions (`ti`) for place × back and place × mode back, and a random intercept for document.

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(mgcv)
```

```{r}
# Fitted models are cached in output/turn_bc_gams/; set refit_models <- TRUE to refit
model_dir <- here("output", "turn_bc_gams")
dir.create(model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
refit_models <- FALSE

fit_or_load <- function(name, expr) {
  path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (!refit_models && file.exists(path)) {
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    model <- expr
    saveRDS(model, path)
    model
  }
}
```

# Data

Same construction as `turn_bc_explore.qmd` (see "Divide into BC or not" there).

```{r}
sbc <- readRDS(here("data", "turns_updated.rds"))
back_given_place_summ <- read_csv(here("data", "conditional_back_summary.csv"))
sbc <- sbc %>% left_join(back_given_place_summ, by = c(text = "word", "place"))
```

```{r}
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(overlap_label = str_extract(transcript, "\\[\\d*"))

unit_info <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_turnType = first(turnType),
    unit_has_overlap = any(isOverlap %in% TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(docId, unitId) %>%
  group_by(docId) %>%
  mutate(
    next_unitId = lead(unitId),
    next_turnType = lead(unit_turnType),
    next_has_overlap = lead(unit_has_overlap),
    next2_unitId = lead(unitId, 2),
    next2_turnType = lead(unit_turnType, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    docId,
    unitId,
    next_unitId,
    next_turnType,
    next_has_overlap,
    next2_unitId,
    next2_turnType
  )

open_brackets <- sbc %>%
  filter(!is.na(overlap_label)) %>%
  distinct(docId, unitId, overlap_label)

sbc <- sbc %>%
  left_join(unit_info, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next2_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next2_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_has_match = coalesce(next_has_match, FALSE),
    next2_has_match = !next_has_match &
      coalesce(next_has_overlap, FALSE) &
      coalesce(next2_has_match, FALSE),
    has_overlap_onset = next_has_match | next2_has_match,
    match_turnType = if_else(next_has_match, next_turnType, next2_turnType),
    has_bc_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*back"), FALSE),
    # Only full, minimal or terminated (abandoned) turns; laughter, vocalisations etc. are neither
    has_turn_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*(full|minimal|terminated)"), FALSE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(docId, turnSeq) %>%
  mutate(
    turn_has_bc_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_bc_onset)),
    turn_has_turn_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_turn_onset))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# As sbc_back in turn_bc_explore.qmd; docId as a factor for the random effect smooth
sbc_back <- sbc %>%
  filter(place != 1, !is.na(mean_back), !is.na(back), !is.na(mode_back)) %>%
  mutate(docId = factor(docId))

sbc_back_bc <- sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_bc_onset)
sbc_back_turn <- sbc_back %>% filter(turn_has_turn_onset)

sbc_back %>%
  summarise(across(c(place, back, mode_back), \(x) n_distinct(x)))
```

# Models

`mode_back` only takes `r n_distinct(sbc_back$mode_back)` values, so its basis is kept small. `ti()` terms hold only the interaction, so the main-effect smooths match the main effects in the GLMMs.

```{r}
gam_formula <- function(outcome) {
  reformulate(
    c(
      "s(place, k = 8)",
      "s(back, k = 8)",
      "s(mode_back, k = 5)",
      "ti(place, back, k = c(6, 6))",
      "ti(place, mode_back, k = c(6, 5))",
      "s(docId, bs = 're')"
    ),
    response = outcome
  )
}

gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int <- fit_or_load(
  "gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int",
  bam(
    gam_formula("has_bc_onset"),
    data = sbc_back_bc,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
)
gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int <- fit_or_load(
  "gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int",
  bam(
    gam_formula("has_turn_onset"),
    data = sbc_back_turn,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r}
summary(gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int)
summary(gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int)
```

Basis size checks (low k-index with a small p-value suggests k is too small):

```{r}
k.check(gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int)
k.check(gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int)
```

Do the smooths beat linear terms? AIC from `bam` is conditional on the document effects (they count as effective df), so it can't be set against the glmer AIC. Compare instead with the linear model fitted the same way:

```{r}
linear_formula <- function(outcome) {
  reformulate(
    c("place * back", "place * mode_back", "s(docId, bs = 're')"),
    response = outcome
  )
}

gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int_linear <- fit_or_load(
  "gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int_linear",
  bam(
    linear_formula("has_bc_onset"),
    data = sbc_back_bc,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
)
gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int_linear <- fit_or_load(
  "gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int_linear",
  bam(
    linear_formula("has_turn_onset"),
    data = sbc_back_turn,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
)

AIC(gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int_linear, gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int)
AIC(gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int_linear, gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int)
```

Sanity check: the linear `bam` fits should reproduce the glmer coefficients.

```{r}
glmm_dir <- here("output", "turn_bc_models")
compare_coefs <- function(glmm_name, gam) {
  beta <- fixef(readRDS(file.path(glmm_dir, paste0(glmm_name, ".rds"))))
  cbind(glmer = beta, bam = coef(gam)[names(beta)])
}
compare_coefs(
  "model_bc_place_back_modeback_int",
  gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int_linear
)
compare_coefs(
  "model_turn_place_back_modeback_int",
  gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int_linear
)
```

# Smooths

```{r}
# Partial effect of each smooth (log-odds, centred), with 95% CIs
plot_main_smooths <- function(model, data) {
  vars <- c("place", "back", "mode_back")
  lapply(vars, \(v) {
    grid <- data.frame(
      place = median(data$place),
      back = median(data$back),
      mode_back = median(data$mode_back),
      docId = data$docId[1]
    )
    grid <- grid[rep(1, 100), ]
    grid[[v]] <- seq(min(data[[v]]), max(data[[v]]), length.out = 100)
    term <- sprintf("s(%s)", v)
    pr <- predict(model, grid, type = "terms", terms = term, se.fit = TRUE)
    tibble(
      variable = v,
      x = grid[[v]],
      fit = pr$fit[, term],
      se = pr$se.fit[, term]
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x, fit)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = fit - 1.96 * se, ymax = fit + 1.96 * se), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Partial effect (log-odds)")
}

plot_main_smooths(gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int, sbc_back_bc) +
  ggtitle("BC onset")
plot_main_smooths(gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int, sbc_back_turn) +
  ggtitle("Turn onset")
```

Fitted surfaces (log-odds; the other variable at its typical value, blank where there's no data nearby):

```{r}

vis.gam(

  view = c("place", "back"),
  plot.type = "contour",
  too.far = 0.1,
  main = "BC: place x back"
)
vis.gam(
  gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int,
  view = c("place", "mode_back"),
  plot.type = "contour",
  too.far = 0.1,
  main = "BC: place x mode back"
)
vis.gam(
  gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int,
  view = c("place", "back"),
  plot.type = "contour",
  too.far = 0.1,
  main = "Turn: place x back"
)
vis.gam(
  gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int,
  view = c("place", "mode_back"),
  plot.type = "contour",
  too.far = 0.1,
  main = "Turn: place x mode back"
)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# Predictions

P(onset) against mode back at several places, with back held at its median and the document effect excluded. As in `turn_bc_explore.qmd`, but only at place / mode back combinations with at least 20 words, since the smooths are unconstrained beyond the data.

```{r}
place_vals <- c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 14)

plot_predictions_gam <- function(model, data, min_n = 20) {
  grid <- data %>%
    filter(place %in% place_vals) %>%
    count(place, mode_back) %>%
    filter(n >= min_n) %>%
    mutate(back = median(data$back), docId = data$docId[1])
  pr <- predict(model, grid, exclude = "s(docId)", se.fit = TRUE)
  grid %>%
    mutate(
      p = plogis(pr$fit),
      lo = plogis(pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit),
      hi = plogis(pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(mode_back, p, colour = factor(place))) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
    geom_pointrange(
      aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    labs(colour = "place", y = "P(onset)")
}

plot_predictions_gam(gam_bc_place_back_modeback_int, sbc_back_bc) +
  ggtitle("BC onset")
plot_predictions_gam(gam_turn_place_back_modeback_int, sbc_back_turn) +
  ggtitle("Turn onset")
```
